learnerTasks.prompt: Explain Mauryan and Gupta India in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of Qin and Han China.
Apply African kingdoms and trade in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving philosophies and religions; correct it and explain why.
Connect Mauryan and Gupta India with regional connections. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Develop a cross-regional comparison centered on institutions, ideas, trade, and innovation.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
